Samir — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. Short answer up-front: we can package the pilot as a time-boxed bundle with discounted retention (metered) + waived dashboard seat surcharge for the pilot term, or as a slab if you prefer predictable spend. Recommended path for a pilot:

- Retention: meter GB/day with monthly cap. For small pilots we suggest metered billing with a soft cap (e.g., 1TB/month) so you only pay for what you use.
- Tracing: two components — ingest (per 1M spans) and storage (GB-month). We can offer an ingest credit against the first 100M spans during the pilot.
- Dashboards: normally seats are $X/seat/mo; for pilots we can waive the seat surcharge for up to 5 seats.

Concession proposal (pilot-only, 3 months):
- 20% off list on retention and tracing unit rates for the first 3 months
- Waive dashboard seat surcharge for up to 5 seats for 3 months
- No onboarding fee (one-time)

I've attached a quick pricing workbook that maps these lines to your SOW and includes a simple invoice scenario. Laura and Kimberly are looped in to confirm commercial guardrails and legal/contract impacts. If that structure works I'll produce a one-page amendment that procurement can sign.

Attachments: pricing-workbook.xlsx

Thanks,

Samir — quick note from commercial: we can tighten Dylan's initial concession and make it procurement-friendly. Two adjustments we recommend so legal has clearer milestones: 

1) Replace the blanket 20% off with a blended pilot rate: 15% off retention/tracing list + a $10k pilot credit applied to the first invoice. This makes the redline simpler (amount-based concession vs % across many SKUs).
2) Waive dashboard surcharge for first 6 months instead of 3 to give your product team time to evaluate without noise. After the pilot we can either revert to list or roll into a committed discount tied to your annual spend.

I attached a copy of the pricing_workbook.xlsx with the blended numbers and a sample invoice line showing how the pilot credit would be applied. If procurement needs a PO-based offset we can accept a short-term credit note.

Questions for you: can you confirm expected retention volume for the pilot (estimated GB/month) and whether tracing will include sampling (we offer 10x compression with sampling which materially reduces storage cost)?
